carnackermario.name: Carnac Stones
carnackermario.slogan: Thousands of stones, marching in rows toward the sea.
carnackermario.line: Kermario alone holds 1,029 stones in ten columns, raised around 3300 BC, long before Stonehenge.

vannesramparts.name: Vannes Ramparts
vannesramparts.slogan: Walk the walls, with gardens at your feet.
vannesramparts.line: Duke John IV of Brittany heavily fortified Vannes and its ramparts, on foundations that go back to the end of the 1st century BC.

portcotonbelleile.name: Port-Coton Needles
portcotonbelleile.slogan: Jagged rocks and wild water, just as Monet painted them.
portcotonbelleile.line: Claude Monet painted these sea stacks again and again during a ten-week stay on Belle-Île in 1886.

josselinchateau.name: Josselin Castle
josselinchateau.slogan: Three towers on the Oust, and a Rohan home since 1370s.
josselinchateau.line: Olivier de Clisson built the present fortress after 1370 with eight towers; Richelieu had four of them pulled down in 1629.

vannesgulfcruise.name: Gulf of Morbihan
vannesgulfcruise.slogan: An inland sea of islands, oyster beds and racing tides.
vannesgulfcruise.line: The gulf holds about 40 islands; two of them, Île aux Moines and Île d'Arz, are towns of their own.
